---
- name: Install and configure PostgreSQL 15
  hosts: all
  become: true
  gather_facts: true

  vars:
    postgres_version: 15
    postgres_port: 5432
    postgres_listen_addresses: 'localhost'
    postgres_allowed_cidrs: []
    postgres_db_name: appdb
    postgres_db_owner: appuser
    postgres_db_password: "CHANGE_ME_USE_VAULT"
    postgres_auth_method: "scram-sha-256"

    postgres_max_connections: 200
    postgres_shared_buffers: "1GB"
    postgres_effective_cache_size: "3GB"
    postgres_maintenance_work_mem: "256MB"
    postgres_checkpoint_completion_target: 0.9
    postgres_wal_buffers: "-1"
    postgres_default_statistics_target: 100
    postgres_random_page_cost: 1.1
    postgres_effective_io_concurrency: 200
    postgres_work_mem: "16MB"
    postgres_log_min_duration_statement: 1000
    postgres_ssl: "off"
    postgres_autovacuum: "on"
    postgres_autovacuum_naptime: "10s"
    postgres_autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor: 0.01
    postgres_autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor: 0.02
    postgres_max_wal_size: "8GB"
    postgres_min_wal_size: "1GB"

  tasks:
    - name: Set PostgreSQL paths and service name for Debian family
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        postgres_service_name: "postgresql"
        postgres_conf_path: "/etc/postgresql/{{ postgres_version }}/main/postgresql.conf"
        postgres_hba_path: "/etc/postgresql/{{ postgres_version }}/main/pg_hba.conf"
        postgres_conf_d_dir: "/etc/postgresql/{{ postgres_version }}/main/conf.d"
        postgres_data_dir: "/var/lib/postgresql/{{ postgres_version }}/main"
        postgres_conf_owner: "root"
        postgres_conf_group: "root"
        postgres_conf_dir_mode: "0755"
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Set PostgreSQL paths and service name for RedHat family
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        postgres_service_name: "postgresql-{{ postgres_version }}"
        postgres_conf_path: "/var/lib/pgsql/{{ postgres_version }}/data/postgresql.conf"
        postgres_hba_path: "/var/lib/pgsql/{{ postgres_version }}/data/pg_hba.conf"
        postgres_conf_d_dir: "/var/lib/pgsql/{{ postgres_version }}/data/conf.d"
        postgres_data_dir: "/var/lib/pgsql/{{ postgres_version }}/data"
        postgres_conf_owner: "postgres"
        postgres_conf_group: "postgres"
        postgres_conf_dir_mode: "0750"
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Ensure prerequisites and repositories are configured (Debian/Ubuntu)
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"
      block:
        - name: Install prerequisite packages
            # Needed for keyrings and HTTPS APT
          ansible.builtin.apt:
            name:
              - ca-certificates
              - gnupg
            state: present
            update_cache: true

        - name: Ensure APT keyrings directory exists
          ansible.builtin.file:
            path: /etc/apt/keyrings
            state: directory
            owner: root
            group: root
            mode: "0755"

        - name: Add PostgreSQL APT repository key
          ansible.builtin.get_url:
            url: https://www.postgresql.org/media/keys/ACCC4CF8.asc
            dest: /etc/apt/keyrings/pgdg.asc
            mode: "0644"
            force: true

        - name: Add PostgreSQL APT repository
          ansible.builtin.apt_repository:
            repo: "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/pgdg.asc] https://apt.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt {{ ansible_distribution_release }}-pgdg main"
            filename: "pgdg"
            state: present
            update_cache: true

        - name: Install PostgreSQL 15 packages (Debian/Ubuntu)
          ansible.builtin.apt:
            name:
              - "postgresql-{{ postgres_version }}"
              - "postgresql-client-{{ postgres_version }}"
              - postgresql-contrib
              - python3-psycopg2
            state: present
            update_cache: true

    - name: Ensure repositories and packages are configured (RHEL/CentOS/Alma/Rocky)
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"
      block:
        - name: Disable built-in PostgreSQL module on DNF-based systems
          ansible.builtin.command: "dnf -qy module disable postgresql"
          when: ansible_distribution_major_version | int >= 8
          changed_when: "'Nothing to do' not in result.stdout"
          register: result

        - name: Install PGDG repository RPM
          ansible.builtin.dnf:
            name: "https://download.postgresql.org/pub/repos/yum/reporpms/EL-{{ ansible_distribution_major_version }}-x86_64/pgdg-redhat-repo-latest.noarch.rpm"
            state: present

        - name: Install PostgreSQL 15 packages (RHEL family)
          ansible.builtin.dnf:
            name:
              - "postgresql{{ postgres_version }}"
              - "postgresql{{ postgres_version }}-server"
              - "postgresql{{ postgres_version }}-contrib"
              - python3-psycopg2
            state: present

        - name: Initialize PostgreSQL database if not initialized
          ansible.builtin.command: "postgresql-{{ postgres_version }}-setup initdb"
          args:
            creates: "{{ postgres_data_dir }}/PG_VERSION"

    - name: Ensure conf.d directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ postgres_conf_d_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ postgres_conf_owner }}"
        group: "{{ postgres_conf_group }}"
        mode: "{{ postgres_conf_dir_mode }}"

    - name: Ensure include_dir is enabled in postgresql.conf
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: "{{ postgres_conf_path }}"
        regexp: "^#?\\s*include_dir\\s*=\\s*'.*'"
        line: "include_dir = 'conf.d'"
        state: present
        owner: "{{ postgres_conf_owner }}"
        group: "{{ postgres_conf_group }}"
        mode: "0644"
        backup: true
      notify: Restart PostgreSQL

    - name: Deploy production tuning configuration
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "{{ postgres_conf_d_dir }}/99-tuning.conf"
        owner: "{{ postgres_conf_owner }}"
        group: "{{ postgres_conf_group }}"
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          # Managed by Ansible - production tuning
          # Network
          listen_addresses = '{{ postgres_listen_addresses }}'
          port = {{ postgres_port }}

          # Connections and Memory
          max_connections = {{ postgres_max_connections }}
          shared_buffers = {{ postgres_shared_buffers }}
          effective_cache_size = {{ postgres_effective_cache_size }}
          work_mem = {{ postgres_work_mem }}
          maintenance_work_mem = {{ postgres_maintenance_work_mem }}

          # WAL and Checkpointing
          wal_buffers = {{ postgres_wal_buffers }}
          checkpoint_completion_target = {{ postgres_checkpoint_completion_target }}
          max_wal_size = {{ postgres_max_wal_size }}
          min_wal_size = {{ postgres_min_wal_size }}

          # Query Planning and IO
          default_statistics_target = {{ postgres_default_statistics_target }}
          random_page_cost = {{ postgres_random_page_cost }}
          effective_io_concurrency = {{ postgres_effective_io_concurrency }}

          # Authentication and Security
          password_encryption = {{ postgres_auth_method }}
          ssl = {{ postgres_ssl }}

          # Autovacuum
          autovacuum = {{ postgres_autovacuum }}
          autovacuum_naptime = {{ postgres_autovacuum_naptime }}
          autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor = {{ postgres_autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor }}
          autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor = {{ postgres_autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor }}

          # Logging
          logging_collector = on
          log_directory = 'log'
          log_filename = 'postgresql-%Y-%m-%d_%H%M%S.log'
          log_line_prefix = '%m [%p] %q%u@%d '
          log_connections = off
          log_disconnections = off
          log_min_duration_statement = {{ postgres_log_min_duration_statement }}
          log_lock_waits = on
      notify: Restart PostgreSQL

    - name: Render pg_hba.conf with allowed CIDRs and secure defaults
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "{{ postgres_hba_path }}"
        owner: "{{ postgres_conf_owner if ansible_os_family == 'Debian' else 'postgres' }}"
        group: "{{ postgres_conf_group if ansible_os_family == 'Debian' else 'postgres' }}"
        mode: "0640"
        backup: true
        content: |
          # Managed by Ansible - pg_hba.conf
          # TYPE  DATABASE        USER            ADDRESS                 METHOD

          # Local connections
          local   all             postgres                                peer
          local   all             all                                     {{ postgres_auth_method }}

          # Loopback
          host    all             all             127.0.0.1/32            {{ postgres_auth_method }}
          host    all             all             ::1/128                 {{ postgres_auth_method }}

          # Allowed CIDRs
          {% for cidr in postgres_allowed_cidrs %}
          host    all             all             {{ cidr }}              {{ postgres_auth_method }}
          {% endfor %}
      notify: Restart PostgreSQL

    - name: Ensure PostgreSQL service is enabled and started
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "{{ postgres_service_name }}"
        state: started
        enabled: true

    - name: Create application database user
      become_user: postgres
      community.postgresql.postgresql_user:
        name: "{{ postgres_db_owner }}"
        password: "{{ postgres_db_password }}"
        role_attr_flags: "LOGIN"
        state: present
      no_log: true

    - name: Create application database
      become_user: postgres
      community.postgresql.postgresql_db:
        name: "{{ postgres_db_name }}"
        owner: "{{ postgres_db_owner }}"
        state: present

  handlers:
    - name: Restart PostgreSQL
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "{{ postgres_service_name }}"
        state: restarted

            update_cache: true

    - name: Ensure repositories and packages are configured (RHEL/CentOS/Alma/Rocky)
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"
      block:
        - name: Disable built-in PostgreSQL module on DNF-based systems
          ansible.builtin.command: "dnf -qy module disable postgresql"
          when: ansible_distribution_major_version | int >= 8
          changed_when: "'Nothing to do' not in result.stdout"
          register: result

        - name: Install PGDG repository RPM
          ansible.builtin.dnf:
            name: "https://download.postgresql.org/pub/repos/yum/reporpms/EL-{{ ansible_distribution_major_version }}-x86_64/pgdg-redhat-repo-latest.noarch.rpm"
            state: present

        - name: Install PostgreSQL 15 packages (RHEL family)
          ansible.builtin.dnf:
            name:
              - "postgresql{{ postgres_version }}"
              - "postgresql{{ postgres_version }}-server"
              - "postgresql{{ postgres_version }}-contrib"
              - python3-psycopg2
            state: present

        - name: Initialize PostgreSQL database if not initialized
          ansible.builtin.command: "postgresql-{{ postgres_version }}-setup initdb"
          args:
            creates: "{{ postgres_data_dir }}/PG_VERSION"

    - name: Ensure conf.d directory exists
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ postgres_conf_d_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ postgres_conf_owner }}"
        group: "{{ postgres_conf_group }}"
        mode: "{{ postgres_conf_dir_mode }}"

    - name: Ensure include_dir is enabled in postgresql.conf
      ansible.builtin.lineinfile:
        path: "{{ postgres_conf_path }}"
        regexp: "^#?\\s*include_dir\\s*=\\s*'.*'"
        line: "include_dir = 'conf.d'"
        state: present
        owner: "{{ postgres_conf_owner }}"
        group: "{{ postgres_conf_group }}"
        mode: "0644"
        backup: true
      notify: Restart PostgreSQL

    - name: Deploy production tuning configuration
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "{{ postgres_conf_d_dir }}/99-tuning.conf"
        owner: "{{ postgres_conf_owner }}"
        group: "{{ postgres_conf_group }}"
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          # Managed by Ansible - production tuning
          # Network
          listen_addresses = '{{ postgres_listen_addresses }}'
          port = {{ postgres_port }}

          # Connections and Memory
          max_connections = {{ postgres_max_connections }}
          shared_buffers = {{ postgres_shared_buffers }}
          effective_cache_size = {{ postgres_effective_cache_size }}
          work_mem = {{ postgres_work_mem }}
          maintenance_work_mem = {{ postgres_maintenance_work_mem }}

          # WAL and Checkpointing
          wal_buffers = {{ postgres_wal_buffers }}
          checkpoint_completion_target = {{ postgres_checkpoint_completion_target }}
          max_wal_size = {{ postgres_max_wal_size }}
          min_wal_size = {{ postgres_min_wal_size }}

          # Query Planning and IO
          default_statistics_target = {{ postgres_default_statistics_target }}
          random_page_cost = {{ postgres_random_page_cost }}
          effective_io_concurrency = {{ postgres_effective_io_concurrency }}

          # Authentication and Security
          password_encryption = {{ postgres_auth_method }}
          ssl = {{ postgres_ssl }}

          # Autovacuum
          autovacuum = {{ postgres_autovacuum }}
          autovacuum_naptime = {{ postgres_autovacuum_naptime }}
          autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor = {{ postgres_autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor }}
          autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor = {{ postgres_autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor }}

          # Logging
          logging_collector = on
          log_directory = 'log'
          log_filename = 'postgresql-%Y-%m-%d_%H%M%S.log'
          log_line_prefix = '%m [%p] %q%u@%d '
          log_connections = off
          log_disconnections = off
          log_min_duration_statement = {{ postgres_log_min_duration_statement }}
          log_lock_waits = on
      notify: Restart PostgreSQL

    - name: Render pg_hba.conf with allowed CIDRs and secure defaults
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "{{ postgres_hba_path }}"
        owner: "{{ postgres_conf_owner if ansible_os_family == 'Debian' else 'postgres' }}"
        group: "{{ postgres_conf_group if ansible_os_family == 'Debian' else 'postgres' }}"
        mode: "0640"
        backup: true
        content: |
          # Managed by Ansible - pg_hba.conf
          # TYPE  DATABASE        USER            ADDRESS                 METHOD

          # Local connections
          local   all             postgres                                peer
          local   all             all                                     {{ postgres_auth_method }}

          # Loopback
          host    all             all             127.0.0.1/32            {{ postgres_auth_method }}
          host    all             all             ::1/128                 {{ postgres_auth_method }}

          # Allowed CIDRs
          {% for cidr in postgres_allowed_cidrs %}
          host    all             all             {{ cidr }}              {{ postgres_auth_method }}
          {% endfor %}
      notify: Restart PostgreSQL

    - name: Ensure PostgreSQL service is enabled and started
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "{{ postgres_service_name }}"
        state: started
        enabled: true

    - name: Create application database user
      become_user: postgres
      community.postgresql.postgresql_user:
        name: "{{ postgres_db_owner }}"
        password: "{{ postgres_db_password }}"
        role_attr_flags: "LOGIN"
        state: present
      no_log: true

    - name: Create application database
      become_user: postgres
      community.postgresql.postgresql_db:
        name: "{{ postgres_db_name }}"
        owner: "{{ postgres_db_owner }}"
        state: present

  handlers:
    - name: Restart PostgreSQL
      ansible.builtin.service:
        name: "{{ postgres_service_name }}"
        state: restarted
